select_exhaustive_policies: select all policies for every player from a GenPSROSolver instance without filtering
select_probabilistic_policies: select policies randomly for each player weighted by their meta-strategy probabilities
select_top_k_policies: select the top-k policies with highest selection probabilities for each player
select_rectified_policies: select policies with nonzero selection probability using rectified Nash logic
select_joint_policies_non_marginalized: select joint policies from non-marginalized meta-strategies using probabilistic sampling
